April, 2025
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Case :- Application U/S 528 Bnss No. - 11721 of 2025

Applicant :- Arvind Patel And 5 Others
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Anurag Mishra,Durgesh Chandra Tiwari

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Arun Kumar Singh Deshwal,J.
1. Heard Sri Anurag Mishra, learned counsel for the applicants and Sri Rakesh Kr. Soni, learned
State Law Officer.
2.

This application has been filed to quash the charge sheet dated 14.08.2021, cognizance order dated 22.01.2025, as well as entire proceeding of case No. 40 of 2025, case crime No. 464 of 2021,
under Sections 147, 323, 498A, IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act, P.S. Soraon, District Prayagraj.

3. Contention of learned counsel for the applicants is that the dispute between the parties is matrimonial in nature and both the parties have settled their dispute amicably and entered into compromise dated 6.3.2025.
It is further submitted that the said compromise has already been filed before the court below.
4. Learned AGA states that the impugned proceeding cannot be quashed until the aforesaid compromise is verified.

entities.text: Arvind Patel And 5 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
In view of the above, the court below is directed to verify the said compromise after summoning the parties within a period of two months from the date of receipt of a copy of this order and after verification, the court below will dispose of the impugned proceeding in accordance with law.
6.
For a period of two months or till verification of compromise, whichever is earlier, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicants in the aforesaid case.
7. However, the parties are at liberty to file a fresh application under Section 528 BNSS to quash the impugned proceeding on the basis of verified copy of compromise, if need arises.
8. With the aforesaid direction, the present application is disposed of.
